title: Three In Four Oceanic Shark Species Face Extinction
hook: The sharks left in open water are already sliding toward extinction.
closing: Losing top predators can destabilize the ocean systems people depend on.
question: Should oceanic fishing limits tighten?

segments.say: Oceanic shark and ray abundance fell 71 percent since 1970. Most vanished within one lifetime.
Oceanic whitetip sharks fell 98 percent. The overall collapse reaches deep into individual species.
Now 75 percent of oceanic shark and ray species face extinction. Decline has become a survival crisis.
